capabilities_done: view::develop CONTROLS: 16 sliders that write hsk-studio-develop recipe fields only: DevelopRecipe.exposure_stops and Adjustments white_balance (temperature, tint), tone (contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks), presence (vibrance, saturation, clarity), detail (texture, dehaze, sharpen.amount, noise.luminance, noise.colour); group enables enable_colour_adjustments / enable_detail switched on only while a gated value is nonzero; DevelopRecipe::validate decides every value (no clamp, no maths here)

every accepted change (Viewer::set_develop / set_develop_many: several sliders = one step) re-develops the original import entry with develop_to_image_threads, tiles it through import::raw_prepare / raw_proposal (the import's raw route split out: interop-psd raster_proposal + Prism converter, same mint so same ids), stages only changed tile bodies and commits them as ONE chronicle tiles edit (Run::set_tiles, op develop) = the UI-2/UI-3 undo/redo path; slider values are remembered per tile-list signature so undo/redo bring back the matching values; identity recipe re-develops to exactly the imported tiles (no step)

Viewer::export_develop: develop_to_output (recipe of the shown pixels, both profile bindings = sha256 of the CC0 sRGB-v4.icc copied to src/view/profiles) -> interop-raster PNG RGB 8/16-bit with iCCP or baseline JPEG 8-bit with APP2 ICC -> decode back (size + profile) -> atomic write; refuses the opened source without overwrite; report carries file/samples sha256, clip counts, route, threads, values
egui develop panel built from hsk-studio-controls descriptors (ids = control ids, plus develop, develop.export.png, develop.export.jpeg); committed slider changes go through set_develop_many

CLI: develop SOURCE OUT (--png [--depth 8|16] | --jpeg [--quality N]) [--adjust CONTROL VALUE]... [--threads N] [--overwrite] through the same Viewer methods; manual, DESCRIPTOR (develop section, proven_by), RUN-UI.md updated

typed refusals (develop::Refusal{code, detail}): develop codes pass through (invalid_adjustment, non_finite, stage_overflow, invalid_limits, a truncated raw's decode code), unknown_control, nothing_to_change, not_a_raw_document, not_open, develop_tile_layout_changed, develop_layer_missing, export_over_source, interop-raster codes; refusals commit nothing
